_note: INF-BACKUP-AUTO-0 approval policies, ratified verbatim by owner decision O-BACKUP-5 (2026-08-16) — see docs/AUTOMATION_ROADMAP.md §INF-BACKUP-AUTO-0. NON-SECRET: this file holds policy metadata only; no credential value may ever appear here (docs/AUTOMATION_SECURITY_AND_SECRETS.md §3). These records do not enable anything by themselves — every run additionally requires the connector to be enabled, the level's feature flag to be on, and a credential supplied by reference only.

policies.note: Read-only operations. backup_verify re-verifies a stored set (completion marker, then per-object checksum — never ETag); retention_report is report-only and deletes nothing.

The LEVEL_4 structural requirements (automation.example.json §automation_levels) are met by the implemented mechanisms: monitoring = O-BACKUP-4 evidence records + mandatory verification steps; audit = secret-free operation envelopes with deterministic idempotency and audit ids; bounded retries = at most one push retry per OFF_HOST_BACKUP_GATE.md §4M, never automatic in the orchestrator; rollback/safe failure = COMPLETE-marker-written-last (an aborted upload is never advertised as restorable) and wholesale discard of the ephemeral restore target.
